officialApp.name: Sensear SmartHub
officialApp.notes: Sensear's app is used to program the headset, including the default power-up mode and the 82 dB(A) volume limiter. The manual also refers to it as the Sensear app. It is a configuration tool, not a battery-percentage app.

battery.chargingIndicators: Indicator LEDs on each side of the headset: red blinking twice every 5 seconds = battery low (<1 hour left); red solid = charging; green solid = charge complete. No percentage steps.
battery.notes: One combined headset battery: 2650 mAh rechargeable lithium-ion polymer. 24 hours with a wired radio connection, 18 hours with Bluetooth and Short-Range active. 5-hour charge (7 hours in some manual revisions). No charging case.

anc.notes: No ANC. Passive hearing protection plus SENS level-dependent 360° situational awareness. SENS amplifies safe ambient sound and suppresses hazardous noise; it is not noise cancellation.

features.name: Certified passive hearing protection
features.notes: Up to 27 dB NRR depending on headband, behind-neck or helmet-mount style; EN 352-1/3/4/6.

features.name: SENS 360° situational awareness
features.notes: Quad SENS microphones reproduce surrounding sound and speech while suppressing noise.

features.name: Programmable 82 dB(A) volume limiter
features.notes: Limits in-ear exposure when the headset is powered on.

features.name: Bluetooth calls and audio streaming
features.notes: Bluetooth 3.0, HFP (8/16 kHz), HSP and A2DP; up to 15 m.

features.name: Short-Range headset-to-headset radio
features.notes: Half-duplex, up to 8 programmable FM channels, approximately 50 m (164 ft).

features.name: Two-way radio connection
features.notes: 6-pin Hirose cable; radio audio passes through the headset even without headset battery.

features.name: FM radio
features.notes: Commercial FM stations; mutes during Bluetooth phone calls.

features.name: Noise-cancelling boom microphone
features.notes: VOX-capable when used with a VOX-enabled radio; IP68 microphone.

features.name: Bluetooth multipoint
features.notes: Not documented; the manual pairs one device at a time.

gestures.notes: Short-Range must be off; pairing times out after 2 minutes.

gestures.gesture: Volume down + power, short press together

controls.physicalButtons: Power, volume +/− and multi-function button on the cup; inline PTT on the radio cable.
controls.notes: Default power-up mode and volume limiter are programmed in the app.

audio.notes: Bluetooth 3.0 with HFP, HSP and A2DP. Codec list is not published. No music EQ.

officialApp.name: Sensear SmartHub
officialApp.notes: Same Sensear configuration app. Battery state is not exposed as a percentage; the headset uses LEDs.

battery.chargingIndicators: Indicator LEDs: red blinking = battery low (<1 hour); red solid = charging; green solid = complete.
battery.notes: One combined headset battery: 2250 mAh rechargeable lithium-ion, 24 hours wired / 18 hours Bluetooth + Short-Range, 4-hour charge. The battery is not user-replaceable and the headset must be returned to Sensear for replacement. Charging is only permitted in a safe area.

anc.notes: No ANC. Passive protection plus SENS level-dependent awareness. Intrinsically safe design for hazardous locations.

features.name: Certified passive hearing protection
features.notes: ATEX/IECEx/UL/CSA intrinsically safe variants; EN 352 and ANSI ratings by mounting style.

features.name: Two-way radio connection
features.notes: 6-pin Hirose cable; radio audio available without headset battery.

features.name: Intrinsically safe certification
features.notes: ATEX/IECEx/UL/CSA; battery replacement and charging restricted to safe areas.

controls.physicalButtons: Power, volume +/− and multi-function button; inline PTT on radio cable.
controls.notes: No charging in a hazardous area; the USB port is service-only.

audio.notes: Bluetooth 3.0 with HFP, HSP and A2DP. Codec list not published.
